# TEI fixtures

These files are GROBID 0.9.1-crf's TEI output for four papers, some of them trimmed or rearranged by hand. They hold text from those papers, which may be shared because each paper is under CC BY 4.0: the licence the Snapshot's arXiv record gives for that Version, or the ACL Anthology gives for that Edition, as `data/manifest.csv` shows. ADR 0033 says why these may be committed while the parse cache may not; `tests/test_parse_fixtures.py` checks every fixture is listed here under a licence the manifest records.

| Fixture | Paper | Authors | arXiv or ACL id | Licence | Changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `wechsel_2112.06598v2.tei.xml` | WECHSEL: Effective initialization of subword embeddings for cross-lingual transfer of monolingual language models | Benjamin Minixhofer, Fabian Paischer, Navid Rekabsaz | 2112.06598v2 | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | GROBID's output, with only its request time (`application/@when`) fixed |
| `wechsel-elements.tei.xml` | the same | the same | 2112.06598v2 | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Trimmed to a few body Sections, one figure and one table in the body, the acknowledgements, two annex Sections with a table, and three references |
| `appendix-in-body.tei.xml` | the same | the same | 2112.06598v2 | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Trimmed and rearranged, with the appendices and acknowledgements in the body; a few headings and one caption are made up for the tests (the file's opening comment lists them) |
| `near-empty.tei.xml` | Neural Machine Translation of Rare Words with Subword Units | Rico Sennrich, Barry Haddow, Alexandra Birch | 1508.07909v5 | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Cut to the abstract and one paragraph of the introduction; funders and bibliography removed; request time fixed |
| `scanned.tei.xml` | the same | the same | 1508.07909v5 | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Cut to the header, with no abstract and an empty body, as for a PDF with no text layer; funders removed; request time fixed |
| `missed-table.tei.xml` | the same | the same | 1508.07909v5 | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Cut to the abstract and Sections 4.1 and 5.1, whose paragraphs hold the cells of tables GROBID missed; figures, funders and back matter removed; request time fixed |
| `lost-heading.tei.xml` | From Where Words Come: Efficient Regularization of Code Tokenizers Through Source Attribution | Pavel Chizhov, Egor Bogomolov, Ivan P. Yamshchikov | 2604.14053v1 | [CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Cut to the abstract, five paragraphs of Section 1 (one holding the head "2 Related Work" GROBID missed) and Section 3; funders and back matter removed; three sentence openings and one copied paragraph are made up for the tests (the file's opening comment lists them) |
| `lost-heading-at-sentence-end.tei.xml` | What do character-level models learn about morphology? The case of dependency parsing | Clara Vania, Andreas Grivas, Adam Lopez | D18-1278 | [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | Cut to the abstract and Sections 1, 2, 2.3 (whose div holds the heads "3 Experiments" and "4 Analysis" GROBID missed) and 4.1; funders, a footnote div and back matter removed |

The papers are at <https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.06598v2>, <https://arxiv.org/abs/1508.07909v5> and <https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14053v1>, and in the ACL Anthology at <https://aclanthology.org/D18-1278/>. A new fixture must come from a Version or Edition the manifest records as CC BY 4.0, and gets a row here.
